critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, automated scans report no confirmed WCAG violations or touch-target failures. Keyboard traversal reaches the thesis navigation links inside the horizontal scroller, and no viewport-level overflow is reported; mobile’s lone oversized decorative element is clipped by #thesis. However, thesis contrast remains unresolved with 24 serious incomplete color-contrast checks at every viewport, including badges, hero text, body copy, and a CTA over gradients. The document has 533–597 unresolved contrast nodes. No reduced-motion test evidence was supplied, and focus visibility/scroll visibility was not explicitly measured.
critique.fix: Resolve and remeasure every contrast-incomplete element against its worst-case rendered gradient/background, adjusting colors or adding solid backplates to meet WCAG. Add Playwright coverage for prefers-reduced-motion that verifies animations/transforms are disabled or reduced. Explicitly test visible focus indicators, focused-item visibility within the horizontal navigation scroller, keyboard activation, and skip-link operation at all three viewports.
